d: On November 10, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps unveiled a new underground secret missile city. Several hundred long-range ballistic and cruise missiles were seen in the footage. However, what stood out was a weapon that was deliberately blurred out by the IRGC. Later in the footage, a cruise missile was seen perched up on a truck that looked very similar to the American JASSM. The JASSM is the Joint Air-to-Surface Standoff Missile, that Iran claims it was able to recover intact during US President Donald Trump's Operation Epic Fury.
